import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .cylinder(41.6, 43.7)
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0.0, 0.0, 20.8), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .sphere(43.7)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0.0, 0.0, -20.8), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .sphere(43.7)
    )
    .cut(cq.Workplane("XY").circle(10.5).extrude(70, both=True))
)
show_object(result)
